performance.cross_question: Kitna fast chahiye? (1) Normal speed ya (2) Ultra-low latency (< 200ms)?
performance.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: P99 Latency < 200ms; ENABLE: CDN Cache

security.cross_question: Security ka level? (1) Normal login ya (2) AES-256 bank-level encryption?
security.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: HTTPS + JWT Auth + AES-256 Encryption

accessibility.cross_question: UI kitna simple rakhna hai? (1) Standard ya (2) Max 3 clicks for any action?
accessibility.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Minimal UI Flow; SET MAX_CLICKS=3
